institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry: requires a pass in 'O' Level Mathematics.

Direct Entry: accepts a minimum of 9 points in IJMB/HSC/GCE 'A' Level/NCE. Candidates with a minimum of lower credit pass in Diploma/HND in Library and Information Science from recognized institutions may also be admitted.

Direct Entry: accepts candidates holding either (a) NCE merit in Library and Information Science or the subject being combined with it, or (b) HSC/'A' Level in two subjects including that to be combined with Library and Information Science.
Direct Entry: requires (a) two 'A' Level passes in relevant subjects, or (b) NCE merit in relevant subjects.
Direct Entry: same as in Vocational and Technical Education.

Direct Entry: accepts (a) two 'A' Level passes in relevant subjects with 'O' Level credit passes in three other subjects at not more than two sittings; (b) three 'A' Level passes with 'O' Level credit passes in two other subjects at not more than two sittings; (c) NCE merit in two major subjects with 'O' Level credit passes or equivalent in three other subjects.

Direct Entry: accepts IJMB/'A' Level/'O' Level credit passes in any three of: any two of Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, ICT and Business Management (ND) with lower credit in Library and Information Science from a recognised Polytechnic, and NCE in Science subjects with minor in Library Science at lower credit or merit; must also have five 'O' Level credits in English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology or Agricultural Science and one credit in Economics, Commerce, Accounting, ICT and Business Management.
Direct Entry: requires 5 'O' Level credits including English and Mathematics plus Diploma in Library Science, or 2 credit passes at Advanced Level, or NCE in Library Science.
Direct Entry: accepts two 'A' Level passes in relevant area or from Arts and Social Science subjects; ND/NCE not below lower credit or nine points in the relevant area from a recognized institution.

Direct Entry: accepts 'A' Level/IJMB passes in at least two subjects; ABU Diploma in Library & Information Science (at least Merit Grade); NCE with minimum Merit Grade in two subjects including Education.
Direct Entry: accepts (a) DELSU Diploma in Library Science with at least merit pass; (b) ND in Library and Information Science from any recognized Polytechnic in upper credit.
UTME: accepts five TC II merit including English Language and a pass in Mathematics.
UTME: same as in Guidance and Counselling.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes at SSC or equivalent in English Language, Mathematics and three other subjects at not more than two sittings.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes at one sitting or six 'O' Level credit passes at two sittings.
UTME: same as in Vocational and Technical Education.

UTME: requires UTME requirements with five 'O' Level credit passes including the subject to be combined with Library and Information Science, plus additional 'O' Level credit requirements for particular combinations.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, four other subjects and 'O' Level pass in Mathematics.
UTME: requires 'O' Level credit pass in Physics and any other Science or Social Science subject.
UTME: accepts 'O' Level pass in Mathematics and 'O' Level credit passes in four other relevant subjects including English Language.
UTME: accepts five 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two sittings.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two sittings including English Language; accepts 'O' Level pass in Mathematics.

UTME: accepts English Language and Mathematics as the core course with 'O' Level credit passes in two Science subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, ICT) and one 'O' Level credit in Economics, Commerce, Business Method or Financial Accounting.
UTME: requires five credit passes including English Language and Mathematics at not more than two sittings.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes at SSC or equivalent including English Language and any other four subjects.
UTME: requires five 'O' Level credit passes including English Language and Mathematics.
